title: C. The Number Of Good Substrings

Let f(t)$$$f(t)$$$ be the decimal representation of integer t$$$t$$$ written in binary form (possibly with leading zeroes). For example f(011)=3,f(00101)=5,f(00001)=1,f(10)=2,f(000)=0$$$f(011) = 3, f(00101) = 5, f(00001) = 1, f(10) = 2, f(000) = 0$$$ and f(000100)=4$$$f(000100) = 4$$$.

input: The first line contains one integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤1000$$$1 \le t \le 1000$$$) — the number of queries.
